rule.declared: 2026-11-07, before reading any of these blocks
rule.sample: inbound TRANSFER receipts from intents.near sorted by block timestamp: every 80th receipt starting at the first, plus the five largest by amount
rule.what_is_read: the blocks from the originating transaction's block to the block in which the receipt executed (at most 8): dip4 native_withdraw / intents_executed and nep245 mt_burn events whose receiver and amount match the receipt, plus any dip4 token_diff event of the same Intents account in those blocks
rule.what_it_establishes: the NEAR arrived as a withdrawal from an Intents-side account balance (observed for every sampled receipt); the purchase itself is the earlier token_diff of the same account, observed only when it falls inside the blocks read, so purchase attribution for the whole inflow remains inferred

receipts.match: native_withdraw event with matching receiver and amount
